thread:
Tara Singh: FYI - ran into an unplanned press mention from TechScope. They posted a quick blurb about our benchmark before our blog went live. Link: https://techscope.example/article/redwood-optimize-mentions. Can PR triage?
Ben Ortiz: Saw it. They used a preview snippet from the embargoed deck. Looks like one reporter ignored embargo. We need a rapid response plan.
Elena Park: Ugh. Are details accurate? Any numbers misquoted?
press-monitor-bot: Detected mention: TechScope article published at 11:12 ET. Matched content vs embargoed appendix: similarity 86%. Flagged potential early publish.
Owen Li: Quick read: they paraphrased the 95th percentile latency number but omitted context. Could be misleading.
Tara Singh: Action items: (1) Ben + Elena reach out to reporter to request hold/take-caveat, (2) comms to prepare corrected paragraph and updated appendix link, (3) ops to check live article link and confirm blog timing.
Ben Ortiz: I'll DM the reporter now. Template: polite ask + offer clarified figures + link to full appendix once live.
Elena Park: Drafting a clarification note. Short version for reporter and a public note if needed. Will post here for review.
commops-bot: Suggested public response template saved to /shared/press/responses/early-mention_template.md. Recommend review before posting.
Ben Ortiz: DM sent to reporter at 11:20 ET: "Hi — thanks for covering. We shared embargoed materials; would you mind holding or adding a clarifying line? We can provide the full appendix at 11:30 ET. Happy to chat"
Tara Singh: Thanks Ben. Elena, drop your draft here when ready. Keep it factual: replace any absolute claims with "observed in our tests" phrasing.
Elena Park: Draft: "We appreciate TechScope's coverage. To avoid potential misinterpretation: the latency figures cited were observed in controlled benchmark tests; real-world results may vary by workload and configuration. We will publish the full methodology and appendix at 11:30 ET." Feedback?
Owen Li: Fine. Add erratum contact line: press@redwood.inference. Then we can push a public clarification on our blog/social if needed.
Ben Ortiz: Reporter replied: "Thanks — we'll append a note and wait for your appendix link." They added a parenthetical clarification.
press-monitor-bot: Monitoring: scanning top 40 outlets for reposts every 5m for 60m. Alert channel = #marketing.
Tara Singh: Ops status? We still on schedule for 11:30 ET publish?
commops-bot: Deploy scheduled: blog:benchmark-followup (v4.1.2) -> prod at 11:30:00 ET. Will post live URL and canonical meta to #marketing on success.
Owen Li: Confirmed deploy queue green. If we need to accelerate, have a plan B (quick blog patch and re-issue).
Elena Park: Sending public clarification to our media list at 11:35 ET if TechScope doesn't update by then. Draft ready.
Ben Ortiz: Also prepping TL;DR for sales and support: "If customers ask, share link to appendix and note 'observed' phrasing."
Tara Singh: Good. Keep updates here. If any large outlet amplifies, we'll escalate to exec comms. Standby 11:20-12:00 ET. :eyes:
